value: NAV frequency: monthly — 'We calculate and publish NAV monthly' solely for establishing monthly sale/repurchase price. Who values: the Adviser (BX REIT Advisors L.L.C.) calculates fair value of real estate properties monthly, based in part on values from third-party independent appraisers; each property valued by an independent third-party appraisal firm annually; monthly reasonableness review by an independent valuation advisor; the independent valuation advisor does not calculate NAV — 'the Adviser is ultimately and solely responsible for the determination of our NAV.' NAV model adjusts assets/liabilities to fair value generally per ASC 820; NAV not audited and not a GAAP measure.
